tools.name: find_london_places
tools.description: Search 463 London sights, museums, parks, markets, hidden gems and day trips from the London Tourist Map, with opening hours checked on official websites, current ticket prices and the nearest Tube station (with step-free access). Use for questions like "free things to do in London", "rainy day idea

tools.name: london_place_info
tools.description: Checked facts for one London sight: opening hours for each day (with the date they were checked), last entry, seasonal closures, ticket price, how long a visit takes, the nearest station and its step-free access, accessibility and address. Use when someone asks "is the Tower of London open on Monday

tools.name: plan_london_trip
tools.description: Plan a 1-7 day London sightseeing trip: groups places into days by area, in walking order, with the time each visit takes and the walks or Tube hops between them. Give the places the person wants, or interests to pick the best-loved ones. Returns the days plus a link to the interactive plan on the L
